sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Pale pink crystal residue known to form when an immortal oath fails to establish.
Increases Resurrective Power to allow an additional resurrection.
To repeat the vows of the undying and be awarded Resurrective Power once more surely necessitates the aid of a Divine Child of the Dragon's Heritage.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Present to Kuro or to the Divine Child of Rejuvenation to gain an additional Resurrection Node.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - If the Young Lord's Bell Charm isn't retrieved prior to the final invasion of Ashina Castle and Outskirts by the Central Forces, this item won't become available in the Offering Box next to Hanbei and it won't be obtainable for the rest of the playthrough, since the Timid Maid will be found dead.
